description:
Declare gate stage and gate mode through the vocabulary macro.

## Background

`GateStage` and `GateMode` (`crates/jit/src/declarations/gates.rs:31-90`) hand-write `as_str` and `FromStr` beside their serde forms.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `GateStage` and `GateMode` are declared through the macro, and their hand-written `as_str` and `FromStr` are gone.
- [hard] REQ-02: Gate registry files load and serialize byte-identically.
title: Gate stage and mode tokens come from one declaration
